# How to build
CMake, Ninja and Conan are required. Ninja is *a must*, because most other generators do not support C++20 modules.
``` sh
# From the project root

# Install dependencies with Conan
conan install . --build=missing

# List CMake presets generated by Conan
cmake --list-presets

# Choose a preset, configure and build
cmake --preset <preset>
cmake --build --preset <preset>
```
